programme.title: Andrew Davies: Rewriting the Classics
programme.desc: Controversial, witty, irreverent, Britain's best known screenwriter, Andrew Davies, has created some of the most iconic small-screen dramas of the past 50 years. At the age of 82 he is following his smash hit adaptation of 'War and Peace' with another global epic, Victor Hugo's 'Les Misérables'. As he watches the production come to life during 2018, he looks back at the influence of his childhood in Cardiff.

programme.title: From Ice to Fire: The Incredible Science of Temperature
programme.desc: Dr Helen Czerski explores the narrow band of temperature that has led to life on Earth. She reveals how life began in a dramatic place where hot meets cold, and how every single living creature on Earth depends on temperature for its survival.

programme.title: The Ruth Ellis Files: A Very British Crime Story
programme.desc: In April 1955 Ruth Ellis shot her lover David Blakely dead. It's a case that shocked the nation and it still fascinates today. It has its place in ushering in the defence of diminished responsibility and the abolishment of capital punishment.

programme.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
programme.desc: Showgirl Lorelei and best friend Dorothy embark upon a boat trip to Paris, where Lorelei intends to marry millionaire Gus Esmond. En route, the girls are bedevilled by private detective Malone, hired by Esmond's father to make certain that Lorelei isn't just another gold-digger. When Dorothy falls in love with the poverty-stricken Malone, Lorelei decides to find her pal a wealthier potential husband.

programme.title: Scene by Scene

programme.title: ... Sings Dylan
programme.desc: A look through the archives at some of the many artists who have come into BBC studios to sing their versions of Bob Dylan songs. Featured performers include Peter, Paul and Mary, Lulu, the Byrds, Joan Baez, Eric Clapton, Madeleine Peyroux, Bryan Ferry, UB40, Julie Felix, Manfred Mann, the Brian Auger Trinity and Pops Staples.

programme.title: ...Sings Dylan II
programme.desc: A feast of cover versions of Bob Dylan songs from the BBC archives, with classic tracks old and new and some surprises too from the 1960s to the present. From the essential folk queen Joan Baez to punk princess Siouxsie and the Banshees, from the Hollies to Adele, taking in the likes of Julie Felix, Richie Havens, Bryan Ferry and KT Tunstall along the way, the programme reflects Dylan's long career of writing extraordinary songs.

programme.title: Bob Dylan: Shadow Kingdom
programme.desc: A showcase of Bob Dylan with his band in an intimate setting as he performs songs from his extensive body of work, including 'Forever Young', 'I'll Be Your Baby Tonight', 'It's All Over Now Baby Blue' and many more.

programme.title: Tangled up with Dylan: The Ballad of AJ Weberman
programme.desc: The life, times and crimes of Bob Dylan obsessive, AJ Weberman, an irreverent and witty exploration into one man's obsessions, a bohemian life lived on the New York fringes and a twisted take on the American Dream. Both hilarious and disturbing, the film is an observation on our unbalanced desires to know more about celebrities and how far we are willing to go to get that information.

programme.title: Mari, Hari a'r Byd Tanddwr
programme.desc: Ymunwn â Mari a Hari wrth iddyn nhw ddarganfod amrywiaeth o gymeriadau doniol a diddorol sy'n byw o dan y môr. Join Mari and Hari as they meet fascinating characters who live under the sea.

programme.title: Tomos a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Mae Persi yn ofni ymgymryd â'i ddanfoniadau post ar Calan Gaeaf oherwydd y Trên Sgrech. Persi is afraid to deliver mail on Halloween because of the Ghost Train.

programme.title: Awyr Iach
programme.desc: Ymunwch gyda Meleri a Huw ar gyfer antur yn yr awyr agored. Meleri kayaks with Llandysul Paddlers, meeting Owen and his grandfather, and Elan teaches Huw how to ride a horse.

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Mae Guto Gwningen yn gadael drws eu cartre' ar agor ar ddamwain yn ystod storm ac mae'n gorlifo. Guto Gwningen accidentally leaves the burrow's door open during a storm and it floods.

programme.title: Annibendod
programme.desc: Mae Bochau wedi cael llond bol ar fwyta bresych, ac felly'n codi pac ac yn mynd ar ei wyliau i Fferm Ty Mawr. Bochau is fed up with eating cabbage all night and day and heads for the farm.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar yr antur popwych heddiw mae Mabli a'i ffrindiau yn chwilio am aderyn prin yn y goedwig! Mai-Mai and her friends are on the lookout for a rare bird in the forest.

programme.title: Howie Shorts
programme.desc: Mae barusrwydd Howie'n cael y gorau ohono yn siop hufen iâ. At the ice cream shop, Howie's greed gets the better of him.

programme.title: Kim a Cêt a Twrch
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cêt ar antur hudolus yn llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth, wrth iddyn nhw chwilio am Twrch yn y goedwig. Join Kim and Cêt on an adventure as they search for Twrch in the forest.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mae Mojo a Bo yn ceisio rhwystro Dot rhag gweld ei hanrheg pen-blwydd, ond mae Dot yn benderfynol! Mojo and Bo don't want Dot to see her birthday present early, but she can't be stopped!

programme.title: Dal Dy Ddannedd
programme.desc: Teams play a series of candyland themed games in order to collect as many clean teeth as possible and win the Dani Dant Trophy.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Mae'r Whws yn darganfod bod peth o'u heiddo ar goll ac am wybod pwy sydd wedi eu cymryd. The Woohoos discover some of their belongings are missing and set out to find out who's taken them.

programme.title: Tomos a'i Ffrindiau
programme.desc: Mae Tomos yn gwirfoddoli i gludo Annie a Clarabel cysglyd ar draws Ynys Sodor heb eu deffro! Thomas volunteers to get a sleeping Annie and Clarabel across Sodor without waking them up.

programme.desc: Tro hwn, dysgwn am y pethau poeth yn ein byd, o'r haul i losgfynyddoedd, ac i un o afonydd twymaf y byd. We learn all about the hot things in our little world, from volcanoes to rivers.

programme.title: Twm Twrch
